heading_path: 33.5. Assignment or transmission of collective trade marks
chunks.text: Federal Register of Legislation - Trade Marks Regulations 1995 Federal Register of Legislation - Trade Marks Act 1995 A collective trade mark may not be assigned or transmitted. This may represent a problem for an association which owns a collective trade mark, should the association become incorporated. Assignment or transmission of the trade mark to the incorporated association would not be allowed.

page.amendment_note: No changes made from previous authorized edits. Thank you
